subtitulo: Cámara en vivo por SRT y RTMP
descripcion:
TuBroadcast convierte tu iPhone en una cámara de transmisión en vivo. La señal sale directo de tu iPhone al destino que tú eliges, sin pasar por servidores intermedios.

TRANSMITE A DONDE QUIERAS
• RTMP y RTMPS: YouTube, Facebook, Kick, Twitch o tu propio servidor.
• SRT: ideal para vMix, OBS y cualquier receptor SRT, en la misma red o por internet.
• Guarda varias conexiones y cambia entre ellas con un toque.

CÁMARA COMPLETA
• Cámara trasera o frontal.
• Micrófono encendido o apagado.
• Linterna para lugares oscuros.

CALIDAD A TU MEDIDA
• Resolución 720p o 1080p.
• Cuadros por segundo y bitrate ajustables.

CONFIGURACIÓN RÁPIDA
• Recibe la configuración de tu productora con un enlace de TuBroadcast y queda lista al instante.

GRATIS Y PLANES
• Gratis: transmisiones de hasta 5 minutos, en 720p y con la marca de agua «TuBroadcast».
• Básico: RTMP y RTMPS sin límites. Completo: RTMP y SRT sin límites. Pase de 24 horas: todo por un día.
• Planes para 1, 3, 5 o 10 celulares, con compra dentro de la app. Las suscripciones se renuevan solas hasta que las canceles en los ajustes de tu cuenta de Apple.
• Términos de uso: https://tukansoftware.com/terminos.html

Hecho en Ecuador por Tukán Software para productoras, iglesias, medios, deportes y creadores que transmiten en vivo.
texto_promocional: Transmite en vivo desde tu iPhone por SRT o RTMP a vMix, OBS, YouTube o tu servidor.
notas_revisor:
1. Screen recording (physical iPhone, latest iOS): {video}

2. Purpose and audience: TuBroadcast turns an iPhone into a live-streaming camera. It is for event production companies, churches, schools, sports leagues and content creators who need to send live video from a phone to a video mixer (vMix, OBS) or to YouTube/Facebook. Problem it solves: a dedicated hardware encoder is expensive; with TuBroadcast any iPhone becomes a camera that sends video over RTMP/RTMPS or SRT directly to the user's own destination.

3. How to use it (no account, no login): open the app > tap the gear (Ajustes) > "Agregar conexión" > enter a destination, e.g. rtmp://a.rtmp.youtube.com/live2 plus a YouTube Live stream key, or srt://host:port for vMix/OBS > Guardar > Listo > tap "EN VIVO". Video and audio go straight from the iPhone to that destination. Camera switch, microphone mute, flashlight, resolution (720p/1080p), frame rate and bitrate are in the main screen and in Ajustes.

4. External services: the video goes only to the RTMP/SRT destination that the user types (YouTube Live, Facebook Live, the user's own vMix/OBS); it never passes through our servers. For licensing only, the app talks to our server panel.tukanec.com: it sends a random install ID (UUID stored in the Keychain, not the IDFA), the device model, the app version and, after a purchase, the StoreKit signed transaction, and receives a signed license. No analytics, no ads, no tracking, no sign-in.

7. In-App Purchases (submitted with this version): Settings (gear) > License > See plans. Plans for 1, 3, 5 or 10 phones: Basic and Complete, monthly or yearly auto-renewable subscriptions (group "TuBroadcast"), and a 24-hour pass (consumable). Without a plan the app works as a free version (720p, "TuBroadcast" watermark, 5-minute limit). After an Apple purchase, the app sends the signed StoreKit transaction to our server, which verifies it with Apple and returns a signed license for the phones in the plan. "Restore purchases" and "Manage subscription" are on the same screen. A TB-XXXX code (bought on our website) can also activate a plan (multiplatform service, guideline 3.1.3(b)); the same plans are always offered with In-App Purchase, and the app has no links or prices for buying outside the App Store.

5. Regional differences: none. The app works the same in every region.

6. Regulated industry / third-party material: not applicable. The app does not provide or host any content; users stream their own camera to their own destinations.
